ValidationRule.description: QCC: Don't change Recovery Status when rejected
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.DonotchangeRecoverystatusonce_rejected__c, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Connect', ISCHANGED(Status__c), OR( OR(Text(PRIORVALUE(Status__c)) = 'Rejected', OR( AND(OR(Text(Type__c)='Credit Card Refund', Text(Type__c)='EFT Refund'), Text(PRIORVALUE(Status__c))='Submit for Finalisation',Text(Status__c)='Finalised', Text(Payment_Status__c)<> 'Approved' ),
AND(OR(Text(Type__c)='Credit Card Refund', Text(Type__c)='EFT Refund'), Text(PRIORVALUE(Status__c))='Submit for Finalisation', Text(Status__c)='Finalisation Declined', Text(Payment_Status__c)<> 'Declined' ) )) ,OR(AND(Text(Status__c)='Submit for Finalisation', Text(PRIORVALUE(Status__c))='Awaiting Approval'), AND(Text(Status__c)='Finalised', Text(Payment_Status__c)<> 'Approved',OR(Text(Type__c)='Credit Card Refund', Text(Type__c)='EFT Refund'), Text(PRIORVALUE(Status__c))='Awaiting Approval') )))
